A laptop is a portable personal computer designed for mobility and convenience. Unlike desktop computers, laptops integrate the display, keyboard, and mouse into a single unit, making them highly portable and ideal for use in various settings. They are powered by batteries, allowing for flexibility and freedom from a fixed location. With advancements in technology, laptops now offer high-performance capabilities, comparable to desktops, while maintaining a sleek and compact design. They are essential tools for students, professionals, and anyone requiring access to computing resources on the go.
